warnings: Pile caps on I-section piles I 0.15x0.15 m, 6.00 m long (F1 6 piles, F2 9 piles). No safe load is printed on the details, so safe_load_t_per_pile is null.
main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F2 is square 1.20 x 1.20, so depth_mm is omitted; F1 is 1.20 x 0.75 (depth_mm = the 0.75 side).

F1's two labels: 10-DB12 points at a cut bar (dot) in the section drawn along the 1.20 side, 7-DB12 at the long bar — read as 10 bars spanning the 0.75 direction and 7 bars spanning the 1.20 direction (kept in bars_by_direction). Fewer dots are drawn than 10 — the printed count is taken.

Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.30, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level that carries no value, so they stay on the elements, not in the grid master's z_levels. The 0.05 printed inside the cap below its top is the RB 9 edge tie line.
